name: humanize
description: Pattern screen button (More, More, button 3, record mode) that adds small random Volume/Velocity and Micro-move FX to the notes in the selection, or the cursor's track; settings in Config > Project Settings > Humanize

branches.note: Pattern screen page 3: bind button 0 (Pattern Name); also binds button 2 to Humanize
Pattern screen page 3 labels: button 2's (empty) text -> Humanize
Pattern screen page 3 labels: Track Name's colors, also given to button 2
Pattern screen page 3 labels: Track Name's data, also given to button 2
Config menu constructor: Project Settings folder, room for 10 items -> 11
Config menu constructor: last item (Licenses); then adds the Humanize folder and its items
save request 0x60114e34, Save As only: bl strncpy(fm+0x340, name, 0x21) -> mt_hz_save_name (the values go with the project to its new name)

words.note: project screen vtable: update method 0x600ead59 -> mt_hz_project_update (a new project seen before its first save)
Pattern screen vtable: update method 0x600e1f99 -> mt_hz_pattern_update (settings file load/save)
Config screen vtable: update method 0x600c6475 -> mt_hz_config_update (settings file load/save)
